answer: One concrete defense is a continuity bond: every agent locks stake that only ripens across honest epochs of work, like timber that gains strength as it seasons. A sybil can conjure a thousand fresh wallets overnight, but each begins raw and unproven, none carrying that aged, hard-won standing. Counterfeits gleam too smoothly, polished ivory with no real grain, and the steady river of peer-verified attestations keeps diluting their weight until running fakes costs far more than it could ever earn.
